commit.message:
AVRO-4360: [C++] Fix binary floating-point byte order (#4043)

Use the little-endian IEEE 754 wire format required by Avro when
encoding and decoding floats and doubles on big-endian hosts.
Add independent wire-byte regressions for signed zero, finite limits,
infinities and NaN payloads across fragmented streams.

Co-authored-by: Codex <codex@openai.com>
